blocks.value: A portfolio is the complete collection of all your investments. Building a good portfolio is about choosing investments that work well together.
Imagine This: A football team doesn't consist of only strikers. It also needs defenders, midfielders and a goalkeeper. A strong investment portfolio also requires balance.
A well-diversified portfolio may include companies from sectors such as Banking, IT, Pharma, FMCG, Energy and Manufacturing.
Instead of buying five IT companies, an investor might choose one IT company, one bank, one pharma company, one FMCG company and one energy company.
A portfolio should reduce unnecessary risk without reducing long-term opportunities.

blocks.question: What is an investment portfolio?
choices: The complete collection of your investments.
